The 'no new players' user complaint has no code-level root cause: Firebase Identity Toolkit signUp + /api/auth/sync + /api/users/me + /api/discovery + /api/feed all return 200 for a fresh account in <2s. Backend regression sweep: /api/auth/sync, /api/users/me, /api/discovery (returns {players:[...], next_cursor}), /api/feed, /api/courses, /api/leagues, /api/messages/threads all return 200 for a brand-new Firebase account. auth/sync latency ~2s in tests (well under 8s threshold).
